description: Merkato sources document a tax/receipt dispute and business closures/strike but no simultaneous public assembly or event-specific count. The claim “hundreds of traders” describes participants in strike action, not necessarily a public gathering.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous merchant/municipal reporting and any photographs or notices for a street demonstration, exact date/place and simultaneous attendance; absent that, retain pending_evidence.

description: Oromia peace rallies are reported across six zones over two days, with competing accounts about government versus community organization. No per-site attendance or exact town/date list is provided. ACLED cites VOA accounts, so independent confirmation is unresolved.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous local reports identifying each gathering, exact date/town, organizer and count of at least 50 at one site; resolve whether sites were coordinated or separate.

description: Student demonstrations following Dereje Amare’s killing are reported across multiple universities and towns, but no per-campus participant counts, precise dates or national coordination are given. “Around 26” refers to protest events, not attendees.
required_followup: Seek campus-specific contemporaneous accounts and exact onset/location/attendance; do not multiply or combine event counts into crowd size.

description: Dera Woreda public protest on 22 Nov and rule-of-law demand are reported through an Oromia Communication Bureau statement quoted by The Reporter; attendance and independent corroboration are unavailable.
required_followup: Locate the original Afaan Oromo Bureau statement and any independent same-day account or crowd estimate; keep attendance unknown until evidence supports threshold.

description: The Addis Insight result URL redirected to a different host that had not been assessed before the initial body request. No facts from the redirect body are used. The source remains search-only; no retry was made.
required_followup: If this source remains materially necessary, assess the exact redirect URL and documented origin before any new request; otherwise use permitted independent reporting.

description: Open-web research used English, Amharic and some Oromo-language/transliterated queries, plus weekly ACLED windows and labor, student, regional peace and public-security leads. No Lexis-Nexis/equivalent newspaper archive or Afaan Oromoo full-text source was examined.
required_followup: Search any permitted Afaan Oromoo and newspaper archives by dates Nov 1–30 and named sites/sectors; check neighboring month boundaries before proposing event ownership.
